req.title: Task title max length
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title exceeds the maximum length constraint.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return an HTTP 422 status code when the task title exceeds the maximum length constraint. This is a functional requirement that ensures data integrity and prevents invalid data from being processed. The test suite includes a positive case to verify normal operation, a negative case to test the constraint violation, and a boundary case to test the edge of the constraint.

tests.name: test_create_task_with_valid_title_length
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded data.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a valid title length.
expected: The response contains the created task with the correct title.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={
        "title": "Valid Task Title",
        "description": "A valid description.",
        "completed": false
    }
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "Valid Task Title"

tests.name: test_create_task_with_exceeding_title_length
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded data.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a title exceeding the maximum length.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

long_title = "X" * 130  # Exceeds max length of 100
response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={
        "title": long_title,
        "description": "A valid description.",
        "completed": false
    }
)

assert response.status_code == 422

tests.name: test_create_task_with_boundary_title_length
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded data.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a title at the maximum length.
expected: The response contains the created task with the correct title.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

max_length_title = "X" * 100  # Exactly max length
response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={
        "title": max_length_title,
        "description": "A valid description.",
        "completed": false
    }
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == max_length_title
